units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:15">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לבך יהגה ת׳</he> may thy heart reason with understanding.

<cite ref="Berakhot 19b:13">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>אין חכמה ואין ת׳ וכ׳</he> ‘there is no wisdom, or understanding, or counsel against the Lord’ (<cite ref="Proverbs 21:30">Prov. XXI, 30</cite>), i.e. worldly considerations may have no weight when the law of God is to be observed; <cite ref="Eruvin 63a:13">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
